notes.title: Fantasy Defense 2
notes.notes:
Hi to all. When I was developing Fantasy Defense (my first video game) I made some mistakes while developing the game due to my inexperience. This is a bad optimization, the presence of significant bugs and other problems of the game that you know.
In three years of creating video games, I have improved my skills and now I am ready to start developing a sequel with new strength.
As for Fantasy Defense 2, it is developed from scratch and most of the problems that were in the first part will be solved.

In the new game you will find new opportunities:
• 5 types of towers
• 5 magical abilities
• ability to summon soldiers
• pump the hero
• set traps along the way
• more advanced system of pumping towers and magic
• as well as a new additional mode of the game Confrontation (similar to the game AirShock)

But there is also bad news. Due to lack of funds, game development is delayed. I have to get a job and I won't be able to spend more time than I would like. You can help me but it's not necessary.

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/nebocryinteractive

notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes: In version 1.2, we fixed a bug with magic. When you could create one force several times. Also fixed a bug with a survival button. When she was always active. The darkest levels have become more vivid. The problem with achievements has not been eliminated.

notes.title: Free game
notes.notes: Due to small sales and leakage of torrent trackers, we decided to make Fantasy Defense a free product.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes: In this update, we come out with early access. In the new version of the game, we added 3 part of the storyline, a new survival map, new units, quest hero and support for in-game achievements.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
In this update, we: 
• added a new tower and magic power: tower of death and powder bomb
• Changed the appearance of the main menu
• Fixed a system of magic.Now the magic icon will disappear only when magic is activated.
• Fixed a bug with invisibility of text in the main menu in the section of settings.
